changes: Added `tidepool sync --watch` to re-run a sync whenever a source file changes
Cold-start time dropped from 900 ms to 310 ms by lazy-loading the plugin registry
Fixed a crash when the config file contained a trailing comma
New `tidepool doctor` command checks credentials, network and cache health in one pass
Config files can now be written in TOML as well as JSON
Deprecated the `--legacy-paths` flag; it will be removed in 4.0
Fixed `tidepool sync` silently skipping files larger than 2 GB
Fixed progress bar flicker on Windows terminals
Plugins can now ship their own shell completions
`tidepool init` asks for a project name instead of guessing from the folder
Upgraded the bundled HTTP client; downloads resume after a dropped connection
BREAKING: removed the `--legacy-paths` flag and the JSON-only config loader
New plugin API v2 with typed hooks; v1 plugins keep working through a compatibility shim
Sync is now 3x faster on repositories with more than 10,000 files
Windows ARM64 binaries are published for the first time
